title: 云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十八章 圣童云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十七章 帝山
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
抬头望去，那峭拔入天的连绵山壁上，竟然长满了深深浅浅的绿树与绚烂如云霞的鲜花，映衬着纯净的蓝天与金色石壁，美丽如画。
凤凰礼队旌旗鼓舞，夹护着白鹤飞车，直冲崖顶。飞骑军们则纵声长呼，分成四队朝悬山掠去。
卡米、许宣随着前方的飞骑绕崖折转，来到了女帝山东侧的山谷。山谷两侧奇峰峭立，绵延成“凹”字形的雄岭。
满眼碧绿，生机盎然。除了几处峭壁与山顶背面的冰川，到处都是郁郁葱葱的森林。瀑布、溪水从积雪皑皑的山顶冲泄而下，穿过层叠山林与织锦般的草甸，汇入天湖。
湖面东侧是一片长满了绿藓的低矮巨石，湖水漫过乱石，飞花碎玉似的朝悬山下冲落，被狂风鼓荡，檬檬如雨雾。众人越过这片天然的石坝，贴着湖面，骑鸟朝山谷内飞掠。
湖西的山坡上巍然矗立着一座高达十八层的白塔，迎着阳光，金芒四射，恢弘而肃穆。塔下是一片依山而建的宫殿，红墙金瓦，一直绵延到峭壁之上。那儿就是卡米所说的神庙了。
听见众人的号角与啸呼，群鸟冲天惊飞，草甸、山林里的野兽也纷纷四散奔逃。许宣、小青东张西望，大感惊奇，想不到在这云海之上的悬山里，居然还生活着这么多珍禽异兽。
卡米身为三十三山的神祝，地位果然与众不同，到了神庙前，早有鼓乐齐奏，数十名白衣人匍匐行礼，将他们迎下龙鹫。那些人虽不识得许宣、小青，但见他们跟在卡米身后，只道是他新收的贴身仆从，无不毕恭毕敬。
卡米低声道：“娘娘，圣上，白日人多眼杂，等日落之后，小人再带你们前往秘道。可乎？”见两人点头示意，方松了口气，传令众人为这两位“阴阳圣童”安排休憩之所。
许宣、小青入住的房间就在绝壁之上，一半嵌入山壁里，一半悬于空中。屋外有栈道回廊蜿蜒相连，通向其他宫殿、屋舍。站在栈道上，狂风鼓舞，金灿灿的飞檐流瓦冲天迤逦，勾心斗角，衬着赭石蓝天，尤为明净壮丽。
屋内简单素净，除了两张木榻和一桌一椅、一灯一柜，别无他物。从窗口朝外眺望，正好对着东面的隘口。白鹤回翔，湛蓝的湖面与湛蓝的天空连成了一片，分不出哪儿是湖，哪儿是天。
卡米生怕两人不满意，又遣人送来了丰盛的点心与水果。那些侍从见神祝如此厚待这对少年男女，也极尽逢迎讨好之能事。
然而经过了这漫长一夜，小青早已困乏不堪，打发走众侍从，连桌上的点心也来不及吃上一口，就呵欠连天，蜷在榻上睡着了。倒是许宣想着王重阳兄妹，想着众蛇人，悲怒酸楚，辗转反复;又生怕卡米趁他们睡熟后悄悄潜入，一直难以入眠。
迷迷糊糊中又想，卡米贪生怕死又奸狡多疑，没找出解除“拔心蛊”的方法之前，绝不敢动自己二人分毫。眼下最要紧的，是尽快找到“白虎皮图”，趁着青帝重伤未愈，将其一举剪灭，一则可为蛇族报仇雪恨，二则足以扬剑立威，让三十三山竞相臣服于自己脚下。若有这数万蓬莱岛民相助，返回临安，救出父母，又有何难？
胡思乱想了一阵，终于睡着了。这一觉睡得极为酣沉，直到黄昏才被窗外的鸟叫声惊醒。
许宣一骨碌坐起身，只见小青倚在窗前，一边啃着桃子，一边喂着两只凤凰。凤凰正争先恐后地啄着她掌心里的果子，听见动响，急忙振翅清鸣，冲天飞起。小青转过头，嫣然一笑，竖指于唇，做了个噤声的手势，然而那对受惊的鸟儿却再不肯飞回来了。
对面的山壁被夕阳镀得灿灿如金，天湖半边湛蓝，半边金黄，不时被微风与俯冲的白鹤搅乱。在蓝天与悬山之间，涌动着滚滚霞云，虹桥虚实掩映，若有若无。
小青转过头时，发丝飞舞，霞光映照在她的笑脸上，明艳得让他的心脏突然停止了跳动。
“都怪你，将它们吓跑啦”小青叹了口气，将那几颗嫣红的野果抛到他的手中，“既然早起的鸟儿不吃了，就便宜你这发呆的大懒虫吧。”
野果色泽莹润，仿佛还带着她手心的余温。许宣心里突突一阵急跳，咬了一口果子，又酸又甜，直沁心底，含混不清地叹道：“你只喂给鸟儿，却不喂给懒虫，好不公平。”

小青脸上微微一红，“呸”道：“不识好歹的臭小子，我也喂只蚕虫给你，瞧你吃不吃。”捋了捋缭乱的发丝，佯装凝望远处的云霞，不再搭理他。
许宣忽然又想起当日和白素贞并立于成都廊桥之上，霞光与她交相辉映的情景，心中又是莫名地一酸。
距离白素贞之死已有两个多月，最初的悲痛已渐渐冲淡，想起她的时候越来越少，对她的倾慕也在不知不觉中迁移到了小青的身上。然而在某些角度、某些时刻，瞥见与她颇为相似的小青时，仍不免会闪掠过和她同生共死的、短暂却又甜蜜的时光，如遭针扎。
当下定了定神，跃落到小青身边，一边嚼着果子，一边伸头探脑地没话找话：“好姐姐，你在看什么？”
小青出神地眺望着云海，没有察觉到他话里的调笑之味，又轻轻地叹了口气：“我在想，世人都说蓬莱是仙山，到了这里就能遇见仙人，得道升天，却不知神仙在哪里？或许真如那姓林的魔头所说，这世上根本就没有神仙。就算真有神仙，也不会来理会我们这些凡夫俗子……”
许宣心中一颤，没想到她竟也和自己戚戚同感。
正不知该如何应答，小青却又扬起眉梢，格格一笑：“罢啦，罢啦，那魔头说的话不听也罢他也不过是一介凡胎，怎知神仙之事？再说，他若真不相信有神仙，又何必费尽心机、历尽磨折，来到这里？最终还搭上一条性命，被烧成了炭糜。”
想到那两魔头已死，她似是心情大好，伸了伸懒腰，嫣然道：“现在‘白虎皮图，有了下落，那两魔头恰好又全都死啦，省了我们好些力气。可惜当初在船上，没能从那些牛鼻子手里抢来‘青龙皮图，，否则四张炼天石图，我们就拿到一半啦”
许宣虽时时刻刻盼着杀死林灵素与李少微，但相处既久，也有了些微妙的感情，此时愿望成真，心底反倒有些莫名的失落。笑了笑，道：“是啊，那两魔头恶贯满盈，活该有此报应。姐姐也再不用担心‘三尸金线蛊，了。”
几枚果子下肚，更觉饥肠辘辘，许宣又狼吞虎咽地吃了半盘点心。小青应是早已吃过，坐在床边，双腿一荡一荡地瞧着他，哧哧直笑。问她笑什么，她摇了摇头，叹道：“我笑你平时鬼灵精般的刁滑，到了这儿却如此大意，你就不怕那卡米以牙还牙，在点心里下些蛊毒么？”
许宣一凛，她却又格格大笑，拣起一枚果子，脆生生地咬了一口，柔声道：“放心吧，傻瓜。我早各挑一样，喂过那些凤凰与白鹤了，若真有蛊毒，它们还能叫得这般欢快么？”
暮色降临后，山谷中华灯渐起，绝壁上红光点点，漫成一片，一直连到那座明亮通透的白塔，蔚为壮观。
卡米遣人将他们领到白塔底座的神殿里，正欲说话，空中突然鼓乐并奏，十几个青衣碧冠的男装美人骑着白鹤翩翩而至，娇声道：“神祝接旨”
众人慌忙匍匐在地，许宣虽不情愿，也只好跟着小青一起伏倒。
那些男装宫女也不跃下，在塔外骑鸟盘旋，领头的女子嘴唇翕动，也不知传音说了些什么，卡米神色大变，不住地磕头道：“是，是，是……”为难地转头瞥了许宣一眼，起身喝道：“圣阳童，青帝陛下传你入宫，还不谢恩乎？
许宣一怔，卡米走到他身边，苦着脸做了个哀求的表情，蚊吟似的低声道：“圣上，那青帝疑心甚重，听闻小人新招了圣童，必欲见过方甫罢休。你随百花使入宫后，小人即刻领娘娘由秘道前往宫中。即便那逆贼真对圣上起了疑忌之意，他经脉毁伤，仅剩五成之力，娘娘、圣上使出‘阴阳电剑，，可轻松取其项上首级也”
许宣原本就胆大包天，来这女帝山的路上也已做了殊死相搏的准备，心想，不入虎穴，焉得虎子？按那卡米所说，青帝寝宫就在“百花宫”的太极眼上，正是找寻“白虎皮图”的最佳机会。大不了和那青帝拼个鱼死网破，为埋在天漏山下的蛇族报仇雪恨
当下不顾小青阻挠的眼色，泰然自若地站起身，按照卡米吩咐，行礼谢恩，跃上鹤背，随着百花使一齐朝崖顶飞去。
小青又惊又恼，奔出神殿，遥遥传音叮嘱道：“小色鬼，我马上就来啦你藏好‘紫龙剑，，切切不可露出马脚，等我到了，再一起双剑合璧……”风声呼呼，骑鸟高上，转眼间她的身影和声音全都消失在下方那沉沉的暮色里了

content_en:
Looking up, the continuous mountain walls that reach into the sky are actually covered with deep and shallow green trees and gorgeous flowers like clouds. They are as beautiful as picturesque against the pure blue sky and golden stone walls.
The phoenix ceremony team carried flags and cheered, guarding the white cranes as they flew straight to the top of the cliff. The flying cavalry troops shouted loudly and divided into four teams to rush towards Xuanshan.
Kami and Xu Xuan followed the flying cavalry in front of them as they turned around the cliff and arrived at the valley on the east side of Empress Mountain. Strange peaks stand steeply on both sides of the valley, stretching into majestic ridges in the shape of a "concave".
Eyes full of green and full of life. Except for a few cliffs and glaciers on the back of the mountaintop, there are lush forests everywhere. Waterfalls and streams rush down from the snow-capped mountain tops, pass through cascading mountain forests and tapestry-like meadows, and merge into Tianhu Lake.
On the east side of the lake is a low boulder covered with green moss. The lake water overflows the rocks and rushes down the mountain like flying flowers and broken jade. It is blown by the strong wind and is like rain and mist. Everyone crossed over this natural stone dam, stayed close to the lake, and flew towards the valley on birds.
On the hillside to the west of the lake stands an eighteen-story white tower. Facing the sun, it shines with golden light, magnificent and solemn. Under the tower is a palace built on the mountain, with red walls and gold tiles, stretching to the cliff. That's the temple Kami mentioned.
Hearing the horns and whistles of the crowd, birds flew into the sky, and wild beasts in the meadows and mountains and forests also fled in all directions. Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing looked around and were surprised. They didn't expect that there were so many rare birds and animals living in the hanging mountain above the sea of ​​clouds.
As the divine blessing of the Thirty-Three Mountains, Kami's status is indeed unique. In front of the temple, drums and music were playing in unison, and dozens of people in white were prostrate and saluted, and they were greeted by the dragon vulture. Although those people didn't know Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing, when they saw them following Kami, they thought they were his new personal servants, and they all treated them with respect.
Kami whispered: "Your Majesty, your Majesty, there are too many people in the daytime. I will take you to the secret passage after sunset. Is that okay?" Seeing the two men nodding, Fang breathed a sigh of relief and ordered everyone to arrange a resting place for these two "Yin Yang Holy Boys".
The room Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing stayed in was on the cliff, half embedded in the mountain wall and half suspended in the air. Outside the house, there are winding plank corridors and corridors, leading to other palaces and houses. Standing on the plank road, the strong wind is blowing, and the golden cornices and flowing tiles are soaring into the sky, intrigues, and the ocher blue sky is particularly bright and magnificent.
The house is simple and plain, with nothing else but two wooden couches, a table, a chair, a lamp and a cabinet. Looking out from the window, it is facing the pass to the east. The white cranes are flying back and forth, and the blue lake surface and the blue sky are connected together. It is impossible to tell which is the lake and which is the sky.
Kami was afraid that the two of them would be dissatisfied, so he sent someone to bring sumptuous snacks and fruits. When the attendants saw that Shen Zhu was treating the young man and woman so favorably, they tried their best to please them.
However, after this long night, Xiaoqing was already exhausted. She sent all the attendants away and didn't even have time to take a bite of the snacks on the table. She yawned all day long and curled up on the couch and fell asleep. Xu Xuan, on the other hand, was thinking about the Wang Chongyang brothers and sisters, and the snake people, and was tossing and turning in grief, anger, and sorrow. He was also afraid that Kami would sneak in while they were asleep, and he couldn't sleep.
He thought vaguely that Kami was greedy for life and fearful of death and was cunning and suspicious. He would never dare to touch the two of them until he found a way to get rid of the "heart-plucking poison". The most important thing at the moment is to find the "White Tiger Skin Picture" as soon as possible, and kill the Qing Emperor in one fell swoop before he recovers from his serious injury. On the one hand, he can avenge the snake clan, and on the other hand, he can use his sword to establish his power and make the Thirty-three Mountains surrender under his feet. If tens of thousands of Penglai Islanders help, return to Lin'an and rescue their parents, how difficult will it be?
After thinking about it for a while, I finally fell asleep. I slept very soundly until dusk when I was awakened by the sound of birds chirping outside the window.
Xu Xuan sat up and saw Xiaoqing leaning in front of the window, gnawing peaches and feeding two phoenixes.. The phoenix was rushing to peck the fruit in her palm. When it heard the noise, it hurriedly flapped its wings and flew into the sky. Xiaoqing turned her head, smiled brightly, pointed to her lips and made a silent gesture, but the frightened pair of birds refused to fly back.
The mountain wall on the opposite side was gilded by the setting sun, and half of the sky lake was blue and half golden, disturbed by the breeze and swooping white cranes from time to time. Between the blue sky and the hanging mountains, there are billowing clouds of clouds, and the Hong Bridge is hidden between the virtual and the real.
When Xiao Qing turned her head, her hair was flying, and the sunlight reflected on her smiling face, so bright that his heart suddenly stopped beating.
"It's all your fault for scaring them away." Xiao Qing sighed and threw the bright red wild fruits into his hands. "Since the early bird won't eat them, I'll take advantage of you, a lazy lazy bug."
The wild fruits are shiny and lustrous, as if they still carry the residual warmth of her palms. Xu Xuan's heart skipped a beat, and he took a bite of the fruit, which was sour and sweet, filling his heart. He sighed vaguely: "You only feed it to the birds, but not to the lazy insects. It's so unfair."
Xiaoqing's face turned slightly red, and she said, "You ignorant brat, I'll feed you a silkworm to see if you eat it." She smoothed her messy hair, pretended to stare at the clouds in the distance, and stopped talking to him.
Xu Xuan suddenly remembered the scene where he and Bai Suzhen stood side by side on the Chengdu Corridor Bridge that day, with the rays of light reflecting off her, and he felt inexplicably sour in his heart.
It has been more than two months since Bai Suzhen's death. The initial grief has gradually faded away. He thinks of her less and less, and his admiration for her has unconsciously transferred to Xiaoqing. However, at certain angles and at certain moments, when I catch a glimpse of Xiao Qing who is quite similar to her, the brief but sweet time of living and dying with her will inevitably flash past, like being pricked by needles.
At that moment, he calmed down and jumped to Xiaoqing's side. While chewing the fruit, he stretched his head and searched for words: "Good sister, what are you looking at?"
Xiao Qing was engrossed in looking at the sea of clouds, unaware of the teasing in his words, and sighed softly: "I was thinking, the world says that Penglai is a fairy mountain. Once you get here, you can meet immortals, attain enlightenment and ascend to heaven, but you don't know where the gods are? Maybe it's like what the devil surnamed Lin said, there are no gods in this world. Even if there are gods, they won't pay attention to ordinary people like us..."
Xu Xuan's heart trembled, but he didn't expect that she felt the same way as him.
Just when he didn't know how to respond, Xiao Qing raised his eyebrows and giggled: "Come on, come on, even if the devil doesn't listen to what he says, he is just a mortal, how can he know about gods? Besides, if he really doesn't believe in gods, why did he go through so much trouble and hardship to get here? In the end, he even lost his life and was burned into charcoal."
Thinking that the two demons were dead, she seemed to be in a good mood, stretched her body, and said sweetly: "Now that the 'White Tiger Skin Picture' has been found, those two demons happened to be dead, which saved us a lot of effort. It's a pity that we couldn't grab the 'Green Dragon Skin Picture' from those Niubi on the ship, otherwise we would have gotten half of the four Heaven Refining Stone Pictures."
Although Xu Xuan always looked forward to killing Lin Lingsu and Li Shaowei, they had been together for a long time and had some subtle feelings. Now that his wish came true, he felt a little inexplicable loss in his heart. He smiled and said: "Yes, those two demons have done a lot of evil and deserve this retribution. My sister no longer has to worry about the 'Three Corpses Golden Thread Gu'."
After eating a few fruits, Xu Xuan felt even more hungry, so Xu Xuan wolfed down half a plate of snacks. Xiao Qing must have already eaten, sitting on the edge of the bed, looking at him with her legs swinging, chuckling. Asked why she was laughing, she shook her head and sighed: "I'm laughing at you for being so naughty and cunning, but now you are so careless. Aren't you afraid that Kami will retaliate in kind and put some poison in the pastries?"
Xu Xuan was shocked, but she giggled again and picked up theHe took a bite of a piece of fruit and said softly: "Don't worry, fool. I have already picked one of each and fed it to those phoenixes and white cranes. If there is really poison, can they still scream so happily?"
After dusk falls, the Chinese lanterns in the valley gradually light up, and dots of red light spread out on the cliffs, all the way to the bright and transparent white tower, which is spectacular.
Kami sent people to lead them to the temple at the base of the white tower. Just as he was about to speak, drums and drums suddenly played in the air. A dozen beauties in men's clothing and blue crowns rode on white cranes and said softly: "God's blessing to receive the decree."
Everyone hurriedly fell to the ground. Although Xu Xuan was reluctant, he had no choice but to fall down with Xiao Qing.
The palace maids dressed in men's clothing also did not jump down, and hovered on birds outside the tower. The leading woman's lips moved, and she did not know what the voice transmission said. Kami's expression changed drastically, and she kept kowtowing: "Yes, yes, yes..." Turning his head to glance at Xu Xuan in embarrassment, he stood up and shouted: "Shengyangtong, His Majesty the Qing Emperor has sent you to the palace, why don't you thank me?
Xu Xuan was startled, and Kami walked up to him, made a pleading expression on his face, and whispered like a mosquito: "Your Majesty, the Qing Emperor is very suspicious. Hearing that the villain has recruited a new Holy Child, he will definitely give up after seeing Fang Fu. After you enter the palace with the Baihua Envoy, the villain will immediately lead the queen to the palace through the secret passage. Even if the traitor is really suspicious of the Holy One, his meridians are damaged and only 50% of his strength is left. The Queen and the Holy One can use the 'Yin Yang Electric Sword' to easily take his head."
Xu Xuan was already extremely daring, and he was already prepared for a life-and-death fight on the way to the Empress Mountain. He thought, if you don't enter the tiger's den, how can you catch the tiger's cub? According to Nakami, the Qing Emperor's palace is located on the Tai Chi Eye of the "Hundred Flowers Palace", which is the best opportunity to find the "White Tiger Skin Picture". The worst case scenario is that we will fight to the death with the Qing Emperor to avenge the snake clan buried under Tianlu Mountain.
Ignoring Xiaoqing's obstructive look, he stood up calmly, followed Kami's instructions, saluted and thanked him, jumped on the back of the crane, and flew towards the top of the cliff with the Flower Envoy.
Xiao Qing was frightened and annoyed. She ran out of the temple and sent a message from afar: "Little pervert, I'll be here soon. Hide the Purple Dragon Sword, and don't show your legs. When I arrive, we can unite the two swords together..." The wind whistled, and the bird flew up. In the blink of an eye, her figure and voice disappeared into the deep dusk below.
